plan.decision: Development pilot only. Decline new state work if either persistent-NVMe5 B/A or B/C normalized mean estimate is below +3%, or convincing service/latency/lower-I/O harm outweighs benefit. A promising result may fund at most one independent fixed confirmation and exact-source qualification; no promotion by this pilot alone, no pooling pilot and confirmation, and no resampling to significance. C/A also evaluates current submitter policy.
